messages:
maya: heads up — customer LedgerNow (dedicated pool dp-07, us-west2) is hitting intermittent 429s and token-level latency spikes on their long-history chat flow. Started ~10:12 UTC.
frank: ticket open (SUP-4982). Any immediate mitigation?
maya: repro in ticket: open chat with ~14k token history, then 6-8 concurrent requests. We see an eviction wave and auth checks pass.
eli: can you paste recent pod/runtime logs + kvcache stats? I suspect lockstep evictions from large prefix batches.
maya: logs excerpt: ```
2026-03-16T10:12:31Z runtime INFO cache: evict storm: prefix_batch=512 tenant=ledgernow
2026-03-16T10:12:31Z runtime WARN alloc: failed to reserve 256MB slab for shard=13
2026-03-16T10:12:32Z autoscale-bot INFO mem_pressure trigger=hard eviction_count=2345 kv_eviction_rate=120/s slab_frag=0.73
```
maya: kvcache-summary: hits=92%, longctx_hit_rate=98%, free_bytes=120MB (on node), compact_count=4 in 5m.
ryan: slab_frag 0.73 + repeated compactions = heavy fragmentation. That would cause small alloc failures even with nominal free bytes. Sounds like eviction cascade, not auth/billing.
frank: customer also saw a billing alert during the burst but tokens billed seem consistent. Not a billing bug atm.
eli: agreed. action: collect heap/fragmentation profile from dp-07 and enable more granular kvcache metrics (per-shard evict/sec, largest-prefix-size). Assigning @ryan to run quick repro.
ryan: running targeted repro now: `loadtest --tenant ledgernow --concurrency 8 --payload longctx-14k.json --duration 5m` — will post results.
maya: ran a quick local run earlier: evict_rate jumped from ~12/s -> ~110/s once concurrency hit 6, latency p50 -> p95 slope rose sharply.
ops-bot: autoscale event: pool dp-07 node node-11 removed due to OOM-evict-policy; reason=alloc-failure.
ryan: quick mitigation trial: lowered runtime `default_prefix_batch_size` 512 -> 128 and restarted affected dp-07 pods.
maya: after restart (10:42 UTC) observed eviction_rate drop to ~15/s and p95 latency normalized. Customer confirmed improvement :thumbsup:.
eli: good short-term. Next: determine whether this is a fragmentation-only issue or an allocation pattern leak for long-context workloads. We'll need heap profiles + slab allocator traces.
frank: CS note: customer asked for summary and potential credits. Hold until 48h stable.
ryan: I'll gather profiling artifacts and upload to /internal/snapshots/ledgernow/dp-07/3475001234. Also capturing loadtest artifacts.
maya: drafting customer-facing summary now, including temporary config change and our plan to investigate.
anna: added an alert: kv_eviction_rate > 50/s for dp-07 tenant=ledgernow, and linked dashboard. I'll monitor for 48h.
eli: owner for follow-up: runtime/alloc team (ryan) to investigate compaction algorithm and consider a targeted backpatch to reduce batch compaction frequency. Devops to consider reserved slab for heavy tenants as a fast mitigation option.
frank: leaving thread open until we have postmortem. Thanks team.
